approval.scope: simulation definitions D2-D5, not hardware feasibility
approval.UcZ: terms touching a leaked cavity are off; all other terms act
approval.energy: per-term |J_ij| on a leaked pair and +b per leaked qubit

fidelity: unconditioned, no leakage renormalization, no postselection

extensions.UcZ_primary: Uz: a term touching a leaked cavity is off; every other term acts
extensions.UcZ_sensitivity: U0 whole component unphased if any cavity is leaked
extensions.energy: per-term Hext: leaked pair contributes |J|, leaked qubit contributes +b
extensions.readout: ideal logical readout; compiled W_L cost is not modelled

classification.threshold: The 1e-9 gate is applied to the norm of a knowingly contractive restriction. A physical tail between 1e-9 and the 1e-8 cutoff budget aborts Nov9 only. QAOA, Nov3rd, and unitary D8 never see that contraction.

asymmetry.note: QAOA and Nov3rd are exactly unitary on the logical space. Nov9th-B exponentiates the projected 8-level generator, which is unitary on that space. Only restricted true-D can lose norm.
